payload.title: Publish revisioned scorecard summaries and CSV exports
payload.description:
As an optimization stakeholder, I want revisioned scorecard summaries and quantitative exports, so that I can understand and share run findings at the appropriate level of detail.

Out of scope:
- New GraphQL models, storage resources, or authorization roles.
- Artifact retention changes.
- Persisting signed download URLs.

Feature: Revisioned scorecard artifacts

Scenario: Publish stakeholder-safe scorecard artifacts
Given a living optimization report reaches a meaningful milestone
When scorecard findings have changed
Then the run publishes one Markdown summary and one CSV for each scorecard
And the CSV contains one row per score
And every artifact is indexed by an immutable revision descriptor

Scenario: Reuse unchanged scorecard content
Given a scorecard summary has not changed since the prior milestone
When a new run revision is published
Then the manifest may reference the unchanged artifact descriptor
And no duplicate content upload is required

Scenario: Produce safe spreadsheet data
Given score names or findings begin with spreadsheet formula characters
When a scorecard CSV is generated
Then those values are escaped as plain text
And the CSV remains readable by common spreadsheet software

Scenario: Reconcile artifact counts
Given a revision contains scorecard exports
When publication validation runs
Then scorecard and score row counts match the presentation evidence
And checksum, size, content type, task key, logical id, and source revision are recorded

Scenario: Keep task attachments bounded
Given a run contains many scorecards
When a revision is published
Then only root run artifacts are attached directly to the Task
And child scorecard artifacts are discoverable through the revision manifest
